easyPrerequisites: Llanowar Tribe doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Staff of Domination's ability, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Resolve the first Staff of Domination ability, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Holding priority, activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Resolve the second Staff of Domination ability, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
